operators.name: softplus_forward

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: same as input tensor (any contiguous shape)
parameters.layout: supports strides; kernel requires contiguous or will handle non-contiguous

semantics: Implements F.softplus(x) with default beta=1, threshold=20: y = log(1 + exp(x)) for x <= threshold, else y = x.
Preserves input shape, stride, dtype and device.
Numerically stable: for x <= threshold compute log1p(exp(x)); for x > threshold return x.
No broadcasting or axis reduction; elementwise operation.

operators.name: relu_forward

parameters.name: x
parameters.shape: same as input tensor (any contiguous shape)
parameters.layout: supports strides; kernel requires contiguous or will handle non-contiguous

semantics: Implements nn.ReLU()(x) (with default inplace=False): y = max(0, x).
Preserves input shape, stride, dtype and device.
No broadcasting or axis reduction; elementwise operation.
Elementwise softplus with beta=1, threshold=20: for each element, if x <= 20 then log(1 + exp(x)), else x.
Input and output tensors are torch.float32 on CUDA, same shape [64, 2048, 2048] and contiguous stride.
Input and output tensors are torch.float32 on CUDA, same shape [64, 2048, 2048] and contiguous stride.
Returns the tensor after softplus and ReLU, torch.float32 on CUDA, shape [64, 2048, 2048], contiguous.
